description: This file is a FastAPI application defining REST API endpoints for an energy insights platform. It includes route handlers for health checks, site management, data ingestion, analytics (timeseries and benchmarking), and alert management. It also sets up middleware for CORS and environmental configuration. The code interacts with a database through a 'db' module, and imports various data models and services for its functionality.

methods.name: health_check()
methods.description: Health check endpoint returning a simple JSON message indicating service health.

methods.name: str docs_help()
methods.description: Returns plain text instructions on how to use the API.

methods.name: list_sites(customer_name: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by customer name (optional)."))
methods.description: Retrieves a list of sites, optionally filtered by customer name.

methods.name: create_site(payload: SiteCreate = Body(...))
methods.description: Creates a new site record using provided site details.

methods.name: upload_readings(payload: UploadReadingsRequest = Body(...))
methods.description: Uploads interval readings and performs duplicate detection and lightweight anomaly alert creation.

methods.name: get_timeseries( site_id: int = Query(..., description="Site ID"), meter_id: str = Query(..., description="Meter ID"), start: datetime = Query(..., description="Start datetime (ISO8601)"), end: datetime = Query(..., description="End datetime (ISO8601)"), )
methods.description: Fetches timeseries data points for a specified site and meter over a time range.

methods.name: list_alerts( site_id: Optional[int] = Query(None, description="Optional site filter"), acknowledged: Optional[bool] = Query(None, description="Optional acknowledged filter"), limit: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=500, description="Max number of alerts to return."), )
methods.description: Lists anomaly alerts, with optional filtering.

methods.name: benchmark( site_id: int = Query(..., description="Site ID"), group_name: str = Query(..., description="Benchmark group name"), start: datetime = Query(..., description="Start datetime (ISO8601)"), end: datetime = Query(..., description="End datetime (ISO8601)"), )
methods.description: Computes and returns benchmarking comparison for a site against a group.

methods.name: seed_demo()
methods.description: Seeds minimal demo data into the database for development purposes.
